faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.whatIs.question: What is Vikunja?
faq.whatIs.answer: Vikunja is an open-source, self-hostable to-do app. It helps you organize your tasks and projects with features like list, kanban, gantt, and table views — all while keeping your data under your control.
faq.free.question: Is Vikunja free and open source?
faq.free.answer: Yes. Vikunja is licensed under the AGPLv3 and completely free to self-host. If you prefer not to manage your own server, [Vikunja Cloud]({cloudLink}) offers a paid hosted option.
faq.install.question: How do I install Vikunja?
faq.install.answer: You can install Vikunja using Docker, native binaries for your platform, or sign up for [Vikunja Cloud]({cloudLink}). Use the [install wizard]({installUrl}) for a guided setup.
faq.selfHost.question: Do I have to self-host Vikunja?
faq.selfHost.answer: No. While self-hosting is a great option, [Vikunja Cloud]({cloudLink}) gives you a fully managed instance with automatic updates, backups, and zero maintenance. It's the easiest way to get started and directly supports the continued development of Vikunja.
faq.import.question: Can I import tasks from Todoist, Trello, or Microsoft To-Do?
faq.import.answer: Yes. Vikunja has built-in migration support for Todoist, Trello, Microsoft To-Do, and other platforms. You can import your existing tasks and projects directly from the Vikunja interface.

home.ownData.title: Your data, your server
home.ownData.text: Run Vikunja on your own infrastructure. Your tasks, your projects, your rules. Open-source under the AGPLv3 — you can read every line of code.
home.team.title: Grows with your team
home.team.text: Start with your personal to-do list. When your team needs it too, share projects, assign tasks, and collaborate — without switching to a different tool.
home.views.title: List, Kanban, Gantt, Table
home.views.text: Four ways to view your tasks. Use whatever fits how your brain works — or switch between views whenever you need to.
home.import.question: Switching from Todoist, Trello, or Microsoft To-Do?
home.quote.title: Getting more organized is hard
home.quote.why: I built Vikunja because there was no good Open-Source Tool to do what I wanted. Privacy is important. For me, you should be able to look at the code of a piece of software you use a lot. Especially if it is something like a to-do app you use daily.
home.quote.cloud: Vikunja Cloud is the best way for me to make sure the project can continue to live on and be self-sustainable. Being completely bootstrapped, the users of the software are the top priority and not some VC.

features.description: Discover Vikunja, the open-source task management tool with powerful features. Stay organized, collaborate, and customize your workflow with multiple views.
features.hero.title: Think of Vikunja like the notebook you have with all your things to keep track of.
features.hero.subtitle: But with superpowers.
features.organized.title: Stay organized
features.organized.text: Organize all of your tasks in projects. Create subprojects to organize everything hierarchically and keep related stuff grouped together.
features.collaborate.title: Collaborate with peers
features.collaborate.text: Vikunja lets you easily share a project with another user or a whole team! Assignments show who's working on what.
features.flexible.title: Use it how you need it
features.flexible.text: You can view your tasks in the classic list view - or in a Gantt Chart, or Table view, or Kanban Board. Whatever you need!
features.openSource.title: Open Source
features.openSource.text: Vikunja is openly licensed under the {license}. You can contribute in multiple ways, even if you're not a developer! It already helps a lot when you use Vikunja and report features you'd like or bugs you find. And if you are a developer and know your way around Go or Vue.js, any help is appreciated.
features.speed.title: Built for speed.
features.speed.text: We built Vikunja with speed in mind - every interaction takes less than 100ms. No more loading spinners.
features.speed.text2: Because a productive tool should not get in your way.
features.tasks.alt: The image shows a minimalist task management interface with a numbered header, breadcrumb navigation, description field, and an embedded colorful abstract image.
features.tasks.title: Tasks
features.tasks.reminders: Tasks are not only simple tasks. You can let Vikunja remind you of tasks when they're due. Never miss an important deadline again!
features.tasks.repeating: Remember that thing you have to do every week but can't get the hang of it? You can set tasks to repeat in a time interval, letting Vikunja remind you of important weekly or monthly tasks.
features.tasks.subtasks: Vikunja also lets you split a task into multiple subtasks for easy progress tracking and more satisfaction when crossing them off the list!
features.quickAdd.title: Quick Add Magic
features.quickAdd.text: Add a task with a due date, labels, assignees and more without having to edit it afterwards?
features.quickAdd.text2: Vikunja's Quick Add Magic lets you do just that! Simply create a task mentioning a date, and it will add it as a due date. Or use one of the special keywords to automatically add labels, assignees and more.
features.views.title: View your tasks in whatever way you like
features.views.text: Vikunja allows you to view tasks in four different views - use whatever works best for you.
features.list.alt: A task management interface displaying an input field to add new tasks, followed by a list of sample tasks with checkboxes, due dates, assignments, labels, and a "Quick Add Magic" feature.
features.list.title: List
features.list.text: The list view is similar to a classic to-do list in a lot of ways. It shows you all tasks in a list underneath each other, enriched with all other task attributes Vikunja has to offer.
features.gantt.alt: Calendar view for July 2022 showing three blue task cards scheduled across different dates and a "Create a new task" button at the bottom.
features.gantt.title: Gantt Chart
features.gantt.text: The Gantt Chart is perfect to get a timely overview of all tasks currently in-progress in a project. It allows for easy planning of deadlines and due dates.
features.kanban.alt: A Kanban-style task board showing two columns, "Backlog" and "Doing", with various numbered task cards containing descriptions, labels, and status indicators.
features.kanban.title: Kanban board
features.kanban.text: Vikunja lets you organize and prioritize your tasks in a kanban board. Quickly get an overview of the status of things - especially when collaborating with multiple people on a project.
features.kanban.text2: Each card on a board represents a task in Vikunja. All tasks can be added through the usual ways and will then show up in the kanban board where they can be easily rearranged and reordered.
features.table.alt: A task list interface showing numbered tasks with titles, completion status, and labels in a sortable table format.
features.table.title: Table
features.table.text: With the table view, you can see all task details of all your tasks. And you can even change what task attributes should be visible!
features.import.title: Import your tasks from Todoist, Trello or Microsoft To-Do
features.import.text: Because work does not happen in one tool only.
features.other.title: Other Features
features.other.labels.title: Labels
features.other.labels.text: Effortlessly mark tasks with a colorful label to find and group relevant tasks with a click!
features.other.filters.title: Saved Filters
features.other.filters.text: Create a filter with only the tasks you care about. Save it once, use it always.
features.other.priorities.title: Priorities
features.other.priorities.text: Know that feeling when you have a dozen things to do but can't decide on what to work next? Vikunja lets you quickly prioritize your tasks, so you'll always know on what to work next.
features.other.delegation.title: Delegation
features.other.delegation.text: Assign tasks to other users or yourself so everyone always knows who is responsible for which task.
features.other.attachments.title: Attachments
features.other.attachments.text: Attach files to tasks, so you can always have all related files for a task in one place!
features.other.relations.title: Relations
features.other.relations.text: Relate different tasks together - even if they're not in the same project! A relation can be multiple things, for example a subtask or blocking task.
features.other.dueDates.title: Due dates
features.other.dueDates.text: Remember these tasks with a deadline coming up? Set a due date for a task and see all tasks with upcoming deadlines at once!
features.other.shareLinks.title: Share links
features.other.shareLinks.text: You can share a project with a link so that others can directly see or edit all tasks in a project but don't need to create an account. Share links have all the same rights management as sharing with users or teams.
features.other.caldav.text: Vikunja comes with a calDAV-integration which lets you use the tools you already use and love.
features.privacy.title: We will never look at your tasks.
features.privacy.text: We will never sell your grocery list or metadata. Because privacy matters.
features.privacy.text2: Don't take our word for it, {checkIt}! Vikunja is openly licensed under the AGPLv3.
